[[File:Colossal blade detail.png|left|130px]]
The '''colossal blade''' is a [[two-handed sword]] purchased from the [[Giants' Foundry]] [[Giants' Foundry Reward Shop|reward shop]] for 5,000 [[Foundry Reputation]], requiring level 60 [[Attack]] to wield.

The colossal blade's stats are similar to those of the [[barrelchest anchor]], with a slightly higher [[slash weapons|slash]] bonus than the anchor's [[Crush weapons|crush]] bonus. Although it lacks a [[Special attacks|special attack]], it has a passive effect to make up for it on larger size monsters. The blade also has much lower requirements compared to the barrelchest anchor, which also requires 40 [[Strength]], in addition to 50 [[Prayer]] and 40 [[Ranged]] for completion of [[The Great Brain Robbery]] quest. Due to this, the blade can be used as a substitute for the anchor on low Prayer, 60 Attack, [[player killing]] builds. The 16, 31, and 44 Prayer builds for example, will benefit from this.

The colossal blade only has to be unlocked once; if lost in any situation, it can be re-obtained from [[Perdu]] for {{Coins|300000}} as long as you do not have another copy of this item. If lost in PVP, the item will drop as {{Coins|225000}} for the killer.

==Passive effect==
The colossal blade has a [[passive effect]] that increases the wielder's maximum hit against larger enemies, calculated as <math>\text{MaxHit} + [2 \times \text{min(MonsterSize,5)}]</math>, meaning max hit is increased by double the monster's size value, but at most by 10 (at a monster size of 5). The <math>\text{MonsterSize}</math> is the number of [[Game square|game squares]] on one side of the monster's occupied space. Example: [[Sarachnis]] is a size 5x5 monster and the <math>\text{MonsterSize}</math> is 5. This bonus does stack with the bonus granted by [[Black mask]].
